target.scope: ND dense MatMulV3 with matching FP16, BF16 or FP32 inputs and output

selection_semantics.winner: minimum simulated critical-path cycles after exact CANN lowering and validation
selection_semantics.tie_break: family name then complete packet fields; deterministic and independent of official output

families.name: BASE
families.applicability: Every input in the target scope has a direct BASE candidate.
candidate_axes: baseM and baseN are positive 16-element multiples projected from Cube issue, output-wave and L0 capacity boundaries
baseK is a positive K0 multiple projected from K extent and L0A/L0B capacity boundaries
stepKa, stepKb, depthA1 and depthB1 are derived together from the exact L1 packet-capacity and 256/512-byte DMA rules
usedCoreNum is chosen only from useful MN task counts up to 20
traversal is each legal permutation of M and N
L2 windows are task-aligned reuse regions and may exceed L2 only as a cache miss, never as a scratchpad allocation
hard_constraints: singleCoreM and singleCoreN cover exactly one BASE task and are not smaller than the inner tile
singleCoreK covers K because BASE has no split reduction
L0A, L0B, L0C, L1 and bias reservations fit
L2 counts and blocks cover every MN task without gaps
suffix 0 is used exactly when an input needs ND-to-NZ workspace; suffix 1 otherwise
cost_components: per-core MN wave and tail imbalance
GM/L2-to-L1 traffic after traversal and L2-window reuse
ND-to-NZ conversion traffic and Vector work

families.name: AL1
families.applicability: FP32, not transA, transB, M<=16, 16<N<=320, K>=4096, K divisible by 128, and the complete aligned A plus B/bias buffers fit L1.
candidate_axes: baseK from full-K divisors at L0A/L0B and remaining-L1 transition points, including non-power-of-two values such as 448
stepKb and depthB1 from legal divisor-aligned B packet and single/double-buffer transitions
usedCoreNum from useful N-task wave counts up to the hardware AIC count
task traversal, L2 task grouping and legal local buffer depths while complete A remains resident
hard_constraints: baseM=16, baseN=16, baseK divides K and singleCoreN=16 for the installed source-backed packet family
singleCoreM=M, singleCoreK covers K, stepKa=K/baseK, depthA1=stepKa
the complete aligned MxK A allocation fits one AIC L1
no ND-to-NZ workspace suffix is dispatched
cost_components: one complete A load per active AIC

families.name: BL1
families.applicability: M>16*max(K,N), K<=256, and B is available through the source on-the-way path or the documented FP32 narrow-A VNCHW path with resident B fitting L1.
candidate_axes: baseN aligned to the B layout and bounded by N
baseK on K0 and L0A/L0B boundaries
baseM on L0A/L0C/L1 capacity boundaries
usedCoreNum from useful M-task counts
M/N traversal and legal L2 groups
hard_constraints: singleCoreN covers N, stepN=ceil(N/baseN)
stepKa=stepKb=ceil(K/baseK), depthB1=stepN*stepKb
singleCoreM=2*baseM and depthA1=2*stepKa for the installed source-backed packet family
the full B resident set plus streamed A packets fits L1
cost_components: one resident B-panel load per active AIC
number of M tasks amortizing that load
Cube, FixPipe and optional A conversion work

families.name: FIXPIPE_BL1
families.applicability: N<256, K<=256, N is neither an output-alignment multiple nor a divisor of it, M>=20*512, and the scalar-bound exclusion holds. FP16/BF16 additionally require not transA and either K is 256-byte aligned or K is below one 256-byte quantum. FP32 does not impose that transA restriction.
candidate_axes: usedCoreNum from useful M tasks
legal local buffer counts
resident-B A-pipeline packet depth when it preserves the complete K iteration
FixPipe versus FP32 Vector NZ-to-ND when the latter's exact predicate holds
hard_constraints: baseN=align16(N), baseM is a positive 128-row multiple fitting L0C and UB
baseK is a positive 16-element multiple fitting double-buffered L0A/L0B
singleCoreM=baseM, singleCoreN=baseN, singleCoreK covers K
B is complete in L1; disabled and task-block L2 scheduler packets are independently legal and both remain candidates
suffix 20201 requires FP32, no A conversion, K divisible by 8 and N<=192

families.name: SINGLE_CORE_SPLIT_K
families.applicability: The source single-core Split-K support predicate holds and the candidate has singleCoreN>=512, average MN occupancy>=0.70, plus the documented 896<=N<=2048 stronger occupancy rule.
candidate_axes: legal MN core grids and aligned parent tasks
baseM/baseN/baseK on scratchpad boundaries
serial K chunk size and packet depth
M-first or N-first traversal
L2 long-axis grouping
hard_constraints: each AIC owns complete MN output tasks; K is not distributed between AICs
singleCoreK=stepKa*baseK, stepKa=stepKb and at least two K chunks execute
later K chunks use the kernel's atomic accumulation path
usedCoreNum does not exceed MN task count
all local memories and L2 task coverage validate
cost_components: repeated result write or atomic accumulation
pipeline fill for each parent task

families.name: DETERMINISTIC_SPLIT_K
families.applicability: The source SupportMultiSplitK predicate holds: low MN occupancy with K>=20*384, the small TA/NT special domain, or the documented K>=27392 domain after its FixPipe-bound rejection.
candidate_axes: MK or NK 3x3 traversal
K partition count derived from executable K chunks up to 20
L2-bounded opposite-axis panel size
hard_constraints: installed 3x3 packet uses baseM=baseN=128 and baseK=256/input_bytes
singleCoreK=3*baseK with the matching 3x1 or 1x3 step/depth profile
at least two AIC K partitions execute
each AIC writes an FP32 partial and AIV reduces in fixed order
the 256-byte FP32 N-tail reducer stride cannot exceed the allocated singleCoreN slot
cost_components: P-1 Vector additions per output element
MK/NK operand traffic and L2 panel reuse

families.name: INCREMENTAL_PATTERN
families.applicability: M<=128, matching FP16/BF16 input and output, ND, not transA, transB, no bias and no ND-to-NZ head conversion.
candidate_axes: the complete finite PATTERN_AL1_FULL, PATTERN_BL1_FULL and PATTERN_NOT_FULL source loops
M/N core dimensions
L1/L0 M/N/K factors
single/double buffer selection
hard_constraints: every source loop candidate is preserved before hardware simulation
converted CANN fields pass the same packet and memory validator as other BASE-key candidates
the source cycle winner is not used as an official tiling seed; every converted candidate is independently rescored
cost_components: the lowered BASE execution graph costs
resident/full-load traffic implied by the pattern fields
Cube, MTE and FixPipe pipeline work

non_installed_families.name: NONDETERMINISTIC_MULTI_CORE_SPLIT_K
non_installed_families.reason: CANN 8.1 DAV-C220 dispatch has no mode-4 suffix.

non_installed_families.name: SINGLE_CORE_SPLIT_K_NKM
non_installed_families.reason: CANN 8.1 dispatch has no mode-5 NKM kernel.

non_installed_families.name: SINGLE_CORE_SPLIT_K_GM_TO_L1
non_installed_families.reason: CANN 8.1 dispatch has no mode-6 manual GM-to-L1 kernel.

non_installed_families.name: SINGLE_CORE_SPLIT_K_AL1
non_installed_families.reason: The installed source and key set do not dispatch the newer combined kernel.

non_installed_families.name: STREAM_K_AND_DP_STREAM_K
non_installed_families.reason: Tail-only cross-core K ownership and partial reduction require the arch35 scheduler/kernel.

non_installed_families.name: ASW_AND_ASWT
non_installed_families.reason: Tail sub-block ownership and dynamic window scheduling are not expressible by the installed 8.1 packet.
